Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx:1763` (`placeYAxes(chartType === 'scatter' ? yAxes?.slice(0, 1) : yAxes, …)` on objectui `origin/main` `f9c06ef`) and the `undrawn` list `placeYAxes` feeds into the note channel ⇒ `domain:ui`. Rationale: the spec's `ChartConfig.yAxis` is an uncapped array. On `scatter`, a second or later entry validates and then draws no axis and prints no note when `series` is authored (measured by the objectui#10691 dev's probe: three `yAxis` entries and one authored `series` ⇒ 0 notes, no `data-chart-error`). This is objectui#10691's class (p3, closed) on the one family its threshold differs for: a declared key silently unused past the first entry, with no named producer ⇒ p3.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01W89enF2dYV7K4N2Fbfj33f` · 2026-09-27T01:35Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card (no comments), `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` on objectui `origin/main`, and objectui#10691's triage comment `5837770949`.

**Execution note.** Take objectui#10691's direction: say so, ⛔ don't narrow. objectui does not own the `yAxis` face, and a narrower mirror would be a second spelling. On `scatter`, an entry past the first gets a visible note naming `yAxis[N]` through the same `ChartFootnote` channel. The cleanest spelling expresses the scatter slice inside `placeYAxes`, so its `undrawn` list carries the entry. Pin a two-entry and a three-entry `scatter` with authored `series`, with the derived-series refusal as the visible control.

Dedupe re-check: every open objectui issue (162), plus the 1000 most recently updated closed issues and PRs, grepped locally for `scatter` near `yAxis` ⇒ PRs objectui#10647 and objectui#10371, and a seat post. objectui#10691 and objectui#10654 (the two-slot families) are closed. No duplicate, and no open closure card to fold into.
